title: tfcfreezer
description: Add a freezer to the Minecraft mod TerraFirmaCraft (TFC), which can consume Forge Energy (FE) to extend the shelf life of food.
body:
New Feature: Two Types of Freezers

This mod adds two types of freezers to TerraFirmaCraft (TFC), both of which provide the same shelf-life extension for food.

-Block Form Freezer
Works when connected to Forge Energy (FE) and turned on with a switch. Once powered on, items cannot be removed from it.

-Item Form Freezer
Works after being charged with FE and activated with a switch. It can only function while placed in the player's hotbar, and cannot be moved within the inventory while it is running. Once turned on, items cannot be removed either.

Despite their different forms and usage methods, both freezers offer the same food preservation effect.

 

本模组为群峦传说（TerraFirmaCraft）添加了两种冰柜，两者提供相同的食物保质期增幅。

-方块形式冰柜
通入 Forge Energy (FE) 并打开开关即可工作。开机后，无法从中取出物品。

-物品形式冰柜
需要先充入 FE 能量，再打开开关即可使用。它只能在玩家的快捷栏中工作，并且开机后无法在物品栏中移  动该冰柜。开机后同样无法取出内部物品。
